trials.claim: Can create unlimited projects, tasks, contexts and folders
trials.claimQuote: Create unlimited number of projects, tasks, contexts and folders
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence to confirm or contradict unlimited projects, tasks, contexts and folders.

trials.claim: All further updates and personal-use features free for AppSumo customers
trials.claimQuote: Get all further updates and personal-use features for free (exclusive for AppSumo customers)
trials.reasoning: The binding terms say premium features may require a paid subscription, which materially limits the promise that all future personal-use features are free. That terms language outweighs one reviewer's expectation about 2025 features.

exhibits.quote: Access to premium features of the Service may require a paid subscription.
exhibits.argument: The terms allow premium features to require a paid subscription, undermining a promise of all future features free.

exhibits.quote: Exciting new features are set to be released in 2025, and these will be included with your purchase.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms future new features will be included with purchase, supporting free updates.

trials.claim: Syncs data across iOS, Android, Windows and Mac
trials.claimQuote: Sync your data across iOS, Android, Windows and Mac
trials.reasoning: The exhibits do not address syncing data across iOS, Android, Windows and Mac: one is about general instability and the other is about calendar sync, not device sync.

exhibits.quote: Very unstable, tasks keep disappearing and need to log in and out multiple times a week.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports tasks disappearing and repeated logouts, undermining reliable cross-device sync.

exhibits.quote: While I can’t sync it across all my calendars, which might be a good thing in some ways
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports inability to sync across calendars, limiting the sync claim.

trials.claim: Includes Daily Plan, Chaos Box and Contexts for schedule control
trials.claimQuote: Gain full control of your schedule with features like Daily Plan, Chaos Box and Contexts
trials.reasoning: The vendor page confirms the Chaos Box feature and a buyer confirms Daily Planning gives a clear, actionable daily plan, with no exhibit undercutting these features.

exhibits.quote: We’ve created a special section — the Chaos Box — specifically for handling tasks, ideas, and information that come in chaotically
exhibits.argument: Vendor's own page confirms the Chaos Box feature exists for handling tasks and ideas.

exhibits.quote: Another great function is Daily Planning—it’s incredibly easy to use and gives me a clear, actionable plan for my day.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms Daily Planning works to give a clear actionable daily plan.

trials.claim: Supports complex activities and goals with projects and categories (folders)
trials.claimQuote: Plan complex activities and achieve goals with projects and categories (folders)
trials.reasoning: The vendor confirms projects can break large-scale work into tasks with checklists, and a buyer confirms setting up the folder system and projects.

exhibits.quote: If you're working on something large-scale, create projects and break them down into tasks with checklists:
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms projects can be used to break down large-scale complex work into tasks.

exhibits.quote: Then, I set up my folder system and created a few projects, though I haven’t used them much yet—I’m sure they’ll come in handy later.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms folder system and projects can be set up in the app.

trials.claim: Helps manage goals, to-do lists and tasks as a personal organizer
trials.claimQuote: A personal organizer that will help you manage your goals, to-do lists and tasks
trials.reasoning: Two buyers directly confirm using it to organize and complete projects and tasks and to manage personal goals and daily routines. The isolated activation and instability reports do not outweigh that direct evidence of it working as an organizer.

exhibits.quote: Activation process stalled after linking purchase code with email address; never received activation email.
exhibits.argument: Buyer could never activate or use the app, so it did not help manage any goals or tasks.

exhibits.quote: Very unstable, tasks keep disappearing and need to log in and out multiple times a week.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports disappearing tasks and instability, undermining use as a reliable organizer.

exhibits.quote: I have been using Chaos Control 2 for a month, and I find it to be an excellent tool for organizing projects and tasks, which helps me complete them more efficiently.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the app helps organize and complete projects and tasks efficiently.

exhibits.quote: I use it to manage personal goals, business projects, subscription renewals, and even daily household routines.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms using it to manage personal goals and daily routines.
